name: Reliance Aqua-Tainer 7-gallon water container
summary: A rigid water-storage container with a reversible spigot and vent cap. Plan safe filling, cleaning and lifting; storage alone does not make contaminated water drinkable.
description: A reserve container is useful only when it can be filled safely, carried to its storage location and dispensed without contaminating the contents. Choose the larger Aqua-Tainer for stationary storage when its loaded weight is manageable. Several smaller containers may be easier to move or rotate. Keep drinking water separate from fuel and household chemicals, and label the fill date as part of a routine storage plan.

specs.label: Nominal size
specs.value: 7 US gallons; current manufacturer page labels this 26 L

specs.label: Empty weight
specs.value: 2 lb advertised; filled weight is substantially greater

specs.label: Dispensing and storage
specs.value: Reversible hideaway spigot, screw vent cap; stack only when empty

pros: A dedicated reserve separates drinking water from general-purpose containers.
A stowable tap keeps the dispensing part protected during storage.
cons: A full rigid container can be difficult to carry.
It provides storage rather than purification.
A rigid reserve needs adequate floor space and a stable dispensing position.
useCases: Organize a stationary household water reserve using a safe water source.
Bring a clean-water container to a planned campsite with a manageable carrying distance.

safetyNotes: Use only potable water and follow local storage and cleaning guidance; this container does not purify water.
Do not stack filled containers; the manufacturer permits stacking when empty.
Protect against contamination, freezing damage and unsafe lifting. A stored supply does not override an avoidance advisory.
